title: Kevin Day radar objects at 28,000 ft matched in data
summary: Merrick tells of Kevin Day radar objects at 28,000 ft matched in data, about 2004 at Off Southern California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, um Kevin Day said that these objects were at 28,000 ft.

plain: A guest named Merrick says on a podcast that Kevin Day, a Navy radar operator in the 2004 incident off Southern California in which Navy pilots chased strange flying objects, reported that those objects were at 28,000 feet. Merrick ties this to data from an infrared camera recording made by a pilot named Chad Underwood, saying the two match, which would mean the radar and the video back each other up.
